caption: Ferdinand Foch (1851–1929), commander of the new 9th Army at the Marne — held the marshes of Saint-Gond against Bülow and Hausen ('my centre is giving way, my right is retreating; situation excellent, I attack'); Supreme Allied Commander in 1918. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph; the horizon-blue uniform post-dates 1914.
credit: Original photograph: Sport & General, Nationaal Archief 158-1095, CC0 (via Wikimedia Commons). Colorization: History Alive, AI-assisted, 2026.
notes: Provided by Dave 2026-08-22. Excellent provenance (CC0, 2300 × 3266). Horizon blue is anachronistic for Sept 1914 — caption it when shown beside the Marne; fine for the Person card and 1918.
